messages:
sara: :rotating_light: Seeing massive evictions on us-west3 GPU pools — autoscaler is thrashing and pages going noisy (gpu-oom, queue-length).

infra-bot: Alert: eviction spike detected in us-west3 (5m window). Autoscaler attempted +4 replicas -> OOM -> rollback. Persistent pod churn.

matt: Oncall here, joining. Any quick mitigations we can do before full investigation?

sara: @matt please pause the autoscaler for the affected gpu-pool for 10m to stop the churn. Also we should tilt new traffic away from us-west3 to eu-north1 where capacity is stable.

diego: Agree on pause. Also propose we tweak incidentbot workflows to reduce alert noise: increase eviction dedupe window and raise autoscaler cooldown. Current autoscaler cooldown (60s) is too low for this workload.

elaine: Heads up — shifting GPUs to eu will affect egress/cross-region cost and some clients' latency. We should add a billing impact note in the incident.

matt: Running tilt now. Command I'm using:
```
rctl route tilt --src us-west3 --dst eu-north1 --percentage 70
```

infra-bot: Traffic tilt initiated: 70% of new sessions routed to eu-north1. Monitor request latencies and session failures.

sara: Pausing HPA for gpu-pool-west3 for 10m to stop reactive scaling:
```
kubectl patch hpa gpu-pool-west3 -p '{"spec": {"minReplicas": 2, "maxReplicas": 2}}' -n inference
```

diego: I've pushed a quick incidentbot/alert rule change to suppress eviction spam. Config snippet applied:
```
alerts:
  eviction_spike:
    dedupe_window: 300  # seconds
    suppression_threshold: 8
autoscaler:
  cooldown: 180  # seconds
```

matt: :thumbsup: Tilt done and HPA paused. We'll watch for side effects. Elaine — can you post a short billing/ops note so CS is aware?

elaine: On it, creating incident note + billing tag and pinging customer-ops.

sara: I'm going to stay on this for the next 30m then handoff to @diego unless we see resolution. Setting a follow-up reminder.

matt: Thanks everyone — we should have a short post-incident follow-up to evaluate long-term autoscaler tuning and route-fallback policies.

diego: Agreed. I'll open a follow-up ticket with the tuning params and a proposal for regional capacity fallback thresholds.
